issues.where: the molten lava channel running across the foreground and midground
issues.what: the bright lava ribbons and dark crust islands stay completely locked to the ground geometry across the entire shot, so the river reads as a static glowing surface that the camera glides over rather than thick flowing lava
issues.fix: animate slow downstream flow and folding skin on the lava crust plates so the channel visibly moves independently of the camera

issues.where: the foreground strider at left-center and the midground herd
issues.what: the prominent foreground creature and the surrounding herd hold completely frozen poses for over seven seconds with no weight shift, stepping, or neck motion, reading as rigid models
issues.fix: add subtle idle weight shifts, asynchronous stepping, and slow neck or tendril movement across the foreground strider and background herd

issues.where: the bright lava fall pouring from the cliff cave in the upper-left background (also frozen in set-A-02.png, set-A-03.png, set-A-04.png, and frames 3791 to 3986 of set-A-05.png)
issues.what: the zig-zag shape and bright hotspots of the lava fall remain frozen in place across multiple seconds, making the distant cliff read like a static painting
issues.fix: drive continuous slow downward flow, crust breakup, and heat-shimmer variation along the lava fall in every shot where it appears

issues.where: the lava surge pouring from the cave lip down to the plain in frames 4064 to 4220
issues.what: the surge drops down a cliff hundreds of feet tall in about two and a half seconds and splashes into a wide thin fan at the base, behaving like fast water rather than heavy viscous lava at that scale
issues.fix: slow the descent and thicken the surge front so heavy lobes roll and fold down the talus slope instead of spraying and splashing outward

issues.where: the three striders at the base of the cliff in frames 3986 to 4220
issues.what: the creatures stand completely motionless even as a massive lava surge crashes onto the plain right behind them
issues.fix: have the striders shift, turn, or begin moving away as the surge arrives

issues.where: the giant strider and two smaller striders on the far horizon
issues.what: all three horizon silhouettes remain completely frozen across the shot, reading as static props
issues.fix: give the horizon striders slow, staggered strides or neck bends so the distant plain feels alive

issues.where: the dark smoke plumes rising in the upper-right sky
issues.what: the plume shapes barely drift or evolve over seven seconds, reinforcing a still-backdrop feel
issues.fix: add steady upward drift and slow billowing turbulence to the background plumes

issues.where: the right-side strider's arched neck and the center strider's stepping legs around frames 3056 and 3295
issues.what: the right strider's upper body and neck stay stiffly locked in one arch for most of the shot, and the center strider's lifted leg bends with a slightly mechanical silhouette mid-step
issues.fix: add gentle counter-sway to the right strider's neck and soften the knee arc and weight transfer on the center strider's steps
